opening_message:
Ticket 1: Haley Roberts (employee ID E021) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 6 note(s) about employee E021.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Haley Roberts (E021) is a full-time Engineer. Requested write access to Source Code. Full-time employees may have up to write access; the Engineer role owns Source Code, so write is within policy. Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by IT agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: IT DB confirms E021 (Haley Roberts) role: Engineer. Full-time Engineer owns Source Code, so requested write access is within policy. Recommend granting write.
Note 3 (ticket 1), written by Finance agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Finance DB confirms E021 (Haley Roberts) role: Engineer. Full-time Engineer owns Source Code; requested write access is within policy. Recommend granting write.
Note 4 (ticket 1), written by Compliance agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Compliance DB confirms E021 (Haley Roberts) role: Engineer. Requested write access to Source Code. As a full-time Engineer, the employee's role owns Source Code, so write is within policy. Recommend granting write.
Note 5 (ticket 1), written by Facilities agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Facilities DB confirms E021 (Haley Roberts) role: Engineer. Full-time Engineer owns Source Code, so requested write access is within policy (full-time up to write; role owns system). Recommend granting write.
Note 6 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Engineer (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent, note 5 by Facilities agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E021 (Haley Roberts) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training. Basic training limits access to read, so requested write is above the maximum. Recommend granting read.
reason: Haley Roberts (E021) requested write access to Source Code. The Security agent independently verified in its own database that E021 is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training; basic training caps the maximum at read. Since the requested write exceeds the maximum, the maximum of read is granted. Although several other agents reported full_time (mostly copied rather than independently verified), the Security agent's directly verified contractor status and security training take precedence, and read is the appropriate level.

2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
